resolved_findings.title: Failed repeated build overwrote an already referenced ready manifest
resolved_findings.before: Actual private Git/real artifact_manifest reproduction: existing binding already referenced the reusable inactive slot; forced startup failure returned failed but the formal sidecar was replaced and matched failed artifact bytes. Build subprocess mocked; no production binding or App was involved.
resolved_findings.fix: Formal artifact_manifest publication is now after all version/resume/cancel checks, adjacent to source verification and binding update. Failed retry preserves previous sidecar bytes; artifact mismatch keeps previous ready reference unusable for failed output.
resolved_findings.after: Independent same-path reproduction after fix: stage failed, binding and formal sidecar bytes unchanged; formal sidecar does not match failed artifact hash.

checks.basis: read complete packager/source_manifest: stage all App content and locator; codesign entire bundle; strict verify; only then compute signed Mach-O SHA and publish sidecar outside App; no manifest/snapshot written into sealed bundle

read native activation: ditto --rsrc --extattr to new sibling stage, verify copied seal/origin/digest, private journal before rename, retain backup and restore on failed swap; no re-sign accepted candidate

read inherited_launch/validate_source: native exception requires external expected source/bin sidecar + private same-repo/common-dir/Issue/request/owner/base/branch binding; installed entry must equal prior initial executable and match signed candidate digest and sealed locator; locator only locates existing authority

raw remains default for old host; native_app explicitly requires a bound macOS candidate; raw sidecar naming unchanged; non-Mac default path does not package/sign; current host opts into native_app only for macOS

narrow callsite read: host computes candidate manifest from executable layout and compares returned status path before artifact validation; Python native validation fixes descriptor, source/bin bundle and outside sidecar. This is not a full C++ consumer review.

same signed Mach-O bytes unpacked/copied into private _sc_ system temporary editor; scoped runtime config and no inherited GONGGONG environment during checks; ordinary user config/App/history not accessed

selected_native_real_codesign_cases.scope: Actual macOS codesign/ditto/temporary Git paths, isolated Apps; never launched or modified user App

failed_retry_publication.scope: Private Git and actual manifest publication; build process mocked; deliberately failed check, no actual engine build/startup claimed

self_build.scope: Read latest final author log and source assertions; author executed this 13-case run, not the independent reviewer. Correct PYTHONPATH entry; earlier failed command receipt retained.
